name: Get feature toggles
description: Call this when you need to determine whether one or more specific feature flags are enabled for the current account. Use a different action such as a feature list endpoint if you need to retrieve all available toggles instead of a specific set.

feature_toggles.description: A comma‑separated list of feature toggle identifiers to query (e.g., "deliv-center-fe" or "sales-task-verification,sales-signal-verification").

feature_toggle.description: A map where each key is a requested feature toggle identifier and the value is a boolean indicating if the feature is enabled.
